Get atlas meshes for 3D rendering

Source: R/atlas_accessors.R
atlas_meshes.Rd

Returns meshes data joined with core region info and palette colours. Used for subcortical and tract atlases.

Usage

atlas_meshes(atlas)

Arguments

atlas

a ggseg_atlas object

Value

data.frame with meshes ready for 3D rendering

See also

Other atlas accessors: atlas_centerlines(), atlas_geom(), atlas_geometry_type(), atlas_labels(), atlas_palette(), atlas_polygons(), atlas_regions(), atlas_sf(), atlas_type(), atlas_vertices(), atlas_views()

Examples

meshes <- atlas_meshes(aseg())
head(meshes)
#> ── <ggseg_meshes> data: 6 × 7 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>                    label vertices faces
#> 1 Left-Cerebellum-Cortex    10618 21228
#> 2          Left-Thalamus     1864  3724
#> 3           Left-Caudate     1512  3028
#> 4           Left-Putamen     1998  3992
#> 5          Left-Pallidum      723  1442
#> 6             Brain-Stem     4608  9212
